name: spotter-build
//: Build-time only. esbuild strips the comments out of the three template modules in build.mjs; nothing here is shipped to a browser and Deno never imports it. stripe is listed because Deno switches to node_modules resolution as soon as it finds a package.json above the function, and without the entry 'deno check supabase/functions/spotter/index.ts' cannot resolve npm:stripe@^22. Run: npm install, then node build.mjs
